regions.region: page 1 title, authors, abstract, and article metadata
regions.finding: Verified the actual article title and the aggregate two-stage Ir/Sc-catalyzed enantioselective formal meta-allenylation claim. The abstract is a current reaction-class summary rather than one experiment-specific run.

regions.region: page 1 two-column Introduction and prior-work discussion
regions.finding: Classified conventional pyridine substitution, reductive dearomatization, Zincke-imine chemistry, and Studer oxazinopyridine chemistry as general/prior context. External cited work was not promoted to current-paper experiments.
The publisher advertises online Supporting Information, but source mapping marks association unestablished; no SI procedure, scope row, or characterization fact was inferred.

unresolved: The abstract and Introduction contain generic structures and aggregate claims rather than experiment-specific charges/outcomes.
No workspace SI association is established.

regions.finding: Figure 1 contains example meta-functionalized pyridines from natural products/catalysis context and no current-paper reaction arrow or experiment.
Separated conventional functionalization, cited reductive/Zincke/oxazinopyridine strategies, and their generic products; these are background records rather than present-paper experimental runs.

regions.region: page 2 Scheme 1c and adjacent hypothesis text
regions.finding: Recorded the current generic oxazinopyridine plus racemic allenylic-alcohol allenylation/rearomatization class. No scheme-level yield was assigned; concrete rows occur on later pages.
Identified oxazinopyridine 2a as the model substrate and linked the experiment to Scheme 2 on page 3; this continuation was not counted as a separate run.

unresolved: Generic R/FG drawings do not define unique structures, quantities, or outcomes.
Figure 1 is contextual and supplies no reaction record.

regions.region: page 3 upper-left Scheme 2a reaction drawing, optimization table entries 1-4, and footnote
regions.finding: Recorded four independent initial-condition experiments with row-specific 2a/3a ratio, temperature, product ratio and combined two-step yield. Entry 1 separately retains 58% first-stage mixture and 90% rearomatization yields; entry 4 separately retains 38% combined versus 36% isolated 5aa.
Recorded optimized 2a-to-5aa and 2b-to-5ba protocols separately with 20 mol% Sc(OTf)3, two ordered 24 h stages, two-step yields, and enantiomeric ratios.

regions.region: page 3 lower-left and right-column Scheme 2 discussion
regions.finding: Mapped narrative yields, isomer mixtures, over-allenylation, catalyst control, and scope transition to the six Scheme 2 records without creating prose duplicates. Missing absolute charges/workups remain explicit.

regions.region: page 3 lower-right beginning of Scheme 3 scope discussion
regions.finding: Linked 5aa/5ba and the 2b-q scope description to the 24 Scheme 3 records on page 4; protected-group behavior is retained through footnotes and notes rather than inferred structures.

unresolved: Scheme 2 omits absolute charges, solvent volumes, workups/purifications, masses, and several analytical bases.
Intermediate 4aa regioisomer position is explicitly undetermined.

regions.region: page 4 upper Scheme 3 reaction header, products 5aa-5xa, caption, and footnotes a-f
regions.finding: Inspected all 24 displayed azine-scope arrows. The repeated 5aa/5ba outcomes were merged into their Scheme 2b records; the other 22 arrows remain independent scope records. Row time, isolated two-step yield, enantiomeric ratio, shared conditions, and footnote-specific protected-form or 0.6/0.2 mmol overrides are retained. The 5aa header-dose conflict is unresolved in its merged record.
Linked 5ra-5ua regioselectivity and the 2-alkyl/2-heteroaryl limitations to the existing scope/context. The 2-heteroaryl low-yield details are SI-only and were not invented.

Linked 5va, 5wa, and 5xa to their Scheme 3 rows and identified 2b plus rac-3 as the Scheme 4 scope platform. Quinoline nonreactivity is qualitative narrative context without a uniquely labeled experimental row.

unresolved: Repeated 5aa has a source dosage discrepancy: Scheme 2b/prose gives 3:1, whereas Scheme 3's shared header gives 0.2/0.24 mmol (1:1.2).
Scheme 3 omits row-specific workup/purification solvents, masses, atmospheres, and separate stage yields.
2-Alkyl pyridine precursor failure and 2-heteroaryl low-yield cases lack main-text identities/quantities sufficient for distinct records.
Complex structures remain source-labeled and machine-unverified.

regions.region: page 5 left Scheme 4 reaction header, products 5bb-5bw and 5xo, caption
regions.finding: Recorded all 23 displayed allenylic-alcohol/combination scope arrows independently with shared charges/conditions, row-specific time, isolated two-step yield, and enantiomeric ratio. The isoquinoline/3o experiment is separate from the 2b series.
Recorded the distinct 1.0 mmol 2b/1.2 mmol rac-3a scale-up, ordered two-stage conditions, 164 mg/74% 5ba, and >99:1 er.

Recorded four independent transformations: Pd/C hydrogenation to 6, ordered ozonolysis then timed -70 to 0 °C NaBH4 warming to 7, carbamate formation to 8, and HCl salt formation/X-ray characterization of 9.

Linked the 3w/5bw and 3o/5xo results, scale-up, and modification discussion to existing records. The alkenyl/alkynyl allenylic-alcohol poor-yield class remains one unresolved main-text record because identities/results are referred only to unassociated SI.

unresolved: Scheme 4/5 omit many solvent volumes, absolute reagent charges, workups, purifications, masses, pressures, and analytical bases.
The alkenyl/alkynyl failure identities and numerical yields are SI-only and remain missing.

regions.finding: Recorded isolated 4ra preparation (38%) separately from the subsequent NCS chlorination and acid rearomatization to 10 (56% over those two stages, >99.5:0.5 er). The two-step yield was not assigned to rearomatization alone or to the full 2r-to-10 sequence.

regions.region: page 6 left-column Scheme 5 continuation and crystallographic discussion
regions.finding: Linked alcohol 7 (78%), carbamate 8, and pyridinium chloride 9/CCDC 2426343 to the existing Scheme 5 records. X-ray assignment of 5ba as R is characterization provenance, not a second preparation or SI association.

regions.region: page 6 left-column bis-allenylation and stereodivergent-synthesis discussion

The conclusion restates the current reaction class and iterative difunctionalization; it introduces no additional experiment-specific quantities or outcomes.
